messages:
zoe: Seeing apiserver 5xx + controller-manager leader flips in ap-northeast-1 starting ~11:02 UTC. correlated with a GPU nodepool onboarding spike. anyone oncall?

tom: I'm watching. etcd leader p99 write latency jumped to 280ms at 11:03. kubelet churn from new nodes is high.

anita: quick grep of provisioner logs: repeated 'WAL fsync delayed' and cloud SNAT exhaustion on the egress nodes. node joins triggered many image pulls + node-exporter checks.

zoe: command snippets: 
```
# kubectl -n kube-system get pods | egrep "apiserver|etcd|controller-manager"
apiserver-apn1   2/2   Running   1   15m
etcd-apn1        3/3   Running   0   40m
controller-manager-0 0/1 CrashLoopBackOff 5 9m
```

tom: mitigation: cordoned the hottest nodepool and slowed the join rate. etcd p99 dropped to ~50ms after ~4m and controller-manager recovered.

anita: hypothesis: concurrent node joins -> SNAT port pool exhaustion + heavy WAL fsyncs amplified by kube-controller-manager reconciliation -> apiserver timeouts.

zoe: short-term: stagger joins, bump SNAT pool for GPU pools, add autoscaler onramp. long-term: implement nodejoin pre-warm and local image cache. tagging ops-RCA.

infra-bot: created ticket RI-OPS-4981 for RCA and owners assigned to infra-net and autoscaler teams.
